title: Some in China question the timing of reports on the relationship between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang; Trump is set to meet Xi Jinping in Shenzhen next week (Mithil Aggarwal/NBC News)
summary: Mithil Aggarwal / NBC News: Some in China question the timing of reports on the relationship between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang; Trump is set to meet Xi Jinping in Shenzhen next week — Reports of resigned CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy may lead to tighter restrictions on U.S. chip sales …
